headline: Introduction of 20% VAT on parcels from Temu and other platforms postponed to November 1
summary: Moldova has postponed the introduction of 20% VAT on purchases from international online platforms such as Temu to November 1, from the planned October 1. Economic operators need time to adapt IT systems.
why: Temu is owned by PDD Holdings, and tax changes on cross-border e-commerce affect its pricing and sales in affected markets.
